# omni_machine_grpc_tunnel (Resource)

Manages the SideroLink connection mode of a single machine: whether its WireGuard traffic to Omni goes over plain UDP or is tunneled through gRPC (HTTP/2), which gets through networks that block or mangle UDP. Without this resource the machine uses the mode its installation media or kernel arguments ask for; destroying it hands the choice back to the machine.

Changing the mode of a connected machine drops its SideroLink peer, so the machine reconnects in the new mode only after its connection times out, which takes about five minutes. Omni accepts the setting before the machine has joined, in which case the machine connects in that mode straight away.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Tunnel a machine's SideroLink traffic through gRPC, for a machine behind a network that blocks
# or mangles the WireGuard UDP traffic. Destroying the resource hands the choice back to the machine.
resource "omni_machine_grpc_tunnel" "edge_0" {
  machine_id = omni_machine_wait.edge_0.machine_id
  enabled    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the machine tunnels its SideroLink traffic through gRPC (`true`) or uses plain UDP (`false`).
- `machine_id` (String) The machine UUID the setting applies to. Immutable.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The setting is imported by the machine UUID.
terraform import omni_machine_grpc_tunnel.edge_0 e8b8e0f0-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
```
